description: Take the background off a picture made before (generated_pictures id) with Higgsfield's remover; the saved picture is changed. Uses a little of the person's Higgsfield credits: the first call only says so; call again with confirm: true after they agree. Optionally puts the result into a shot or the Media bin (as). For free trimming, cropping or flipping of a picture already in a shot, use cutout.

as.description: Where to put the cut-out; leave out to only change the saved picture.

confirm.description: true only after the person agreed to spend the credits.

replace.description: A cast member id in that shot whose picture this replaces.

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: The shot's id from get_project. Or give scene and shot instead. Left out: the shot on screen.

name: remove_background
